<<<POU name=JamPump kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK JamPump
VAR_INPUT
    VISCOSITY_OK : BOOL;
    PASTE_E_STOP_NC : BOOL;
    DebounceTime : TIME;
    CycleTime : TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    VFD_RUN : BOOL;
    PUMP_MAINT_DUE : BOOL;
    PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC : LTIME;
END_VAR
VAR
    debounceElapsed : LTIME := LTIME#0ms;
    viscValid : BOOL;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
IF NOT VISCOSITY_OK THEN
(* intentional bug for mock *)
mock_undeclared_var_xyz := 1;
    viscValid := FALSE;
    debounceElapsed := LTIME#0ms;
ELSIF NOT PASTE_E_STOP_NC THEN
    viscValid := FALSE;
    debounceElapsed := LTIME#0ms;
ELSIF NOT viscValid THEN
    debounceElapsed := debounceElapsed + TO_LTIME(CycleTime);
    IF debounceElapsed >= TO_LTIME(DebounceTime) THEN
        viscValid := TRUE;
    END_IF
END_IF
IF PASTE_E_STOP_NC AND viscValid THEN
    VFD_RUN := TRUE;
ELSE
    VFD_RUN := FALSE;
END_IF
IF VFD_RUN THEN
    PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC := PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC + TO_LTIME(CycleTime);
END_IF
IF PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC >= TO_LTIME(T#500h) THEN
    PUMP_MAINT_DUE := TRUE;
END_IF
<<<END>>>
